verdict.rationale: PostHog AI is documented as an in-product analyst in a chat sidebar and inline UI entry points. It answers plain-English questions by querying data, building insights, writing SQL and explaining its findings. Self-driving adds proactive suggestions by spotting patterns and turning signals into reports and PRs, and Replay Vision uses AI to summarize sessions and score frustration. One hands-on community report says the in-product LLM refused to create a SQL-based cohort and made the UI very slow, which limits confidence but does not contradict the core capability. Missing for 10: independent corroboration that the generated insights are good, and evidence that the in-product assistant performs reliably (the community report cites UI slowdown and capability gaps).
